lead: `python tools/dossier.py --record-perf` refuses to measure on a busy machine, and the answer is to run it again.
body: Its calibration prices one iteration by timing an empty program against a unit one, so when something else holds the CPU the unit's fastest run lands below the floor's and it raises `the calibration did not measure anything` — the bench is not what is wrong. Re-run it: three refusals in a row are ordinary on this box, and changing `--reps` is not what makes the next one land.
